item.title: Tamarinda hit by 6.4 magnitude quake; no tsunami warning
item.description: Tamarinda hit by 6.4 magnitude quake; no tsunami warning. The quake struck about 40 kilometres offshore at a shallow depth, the geological survey said. At least 12 people were killed and dozens injured, local officials said.

item.title: Thousands evacuated as wildfires spread across Mirabel province
item.description: Thousands evacuated as wildfires spread across Mirabel province. Emergency services said more than 3,000 residents had been told to leave their homes.

item.title: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire
item.description: Geneva talks: Estovia, Karelan envoys meet on border ceasefire. Negotiators from both sides met for a second day at a hotel in Geneva. Mediators said discussions focused on a monitored ceasefire along the border.

item.title: Norvanian central bank leaves benchmark rate on hold
item.description: Norvanian central bank leaves benchmark rate on hold. The bank signalled that any future cuts would depend on incoming data.
